title: Web board: an Inbox page of what needs the user
summary: Spec v2: a board view after Home, on a project and All projects: open questions, approvals asked, PRs ready to merge, blocked CRs (paused batch too), from a read-only needs_you field. Open, Snooze 1 h, Later 08:00, Discard, kept in the browser; counts, guarded opt-in notification.
